# Draft:19th South African Film and Television Awards

The 19th edition of the South African Film & Television Awards, presented by the National Film and Video Foundation, were held at the Gallagher Convention Centre in Midrand for two nights. The craft awards were hosted on March 13, 2026, while the main awards took place on March 14, honoring achievements in the South African film and television Industry for the period of 1 January 2024 to 30 June 2025. The Craft Awards were streamed live on YouTube on 13 March 2026, while the main ceremony were broadcast on 14 March 2026 on Mzansi Magic and SABC 2, and streamed through DStv Stream and SABC+.

Winners and nominees
The nominations were announced on 17 February 2026. A total of 471 submissions were received across all categories. Production company Tshedza Pictures led the nominations with 24, followed by Quizzical Pictures with 22 and Penguin Films with 17.

Background
Initially scheduled for October 2025, the ceremony was later postponed to March 2026 due to leadership changes and organisational restructuring within the NFVF.
According to the organisation, the postponement was intended to allow for governance reforms and to align the awards with the international film awards calendar. This also resulted in the extension of the eligibility window to 18 months, ensuring eligibility for productions released during the additional period.
